text: I used to feel a deep, clear connection with the animals, but for the past eight months, that link has vanished, leaving me feeling like my health is failing. speaker: Doctor
text: Given the confirmed diagnosis of Z-Syndrome, I will not order any further tests as instructed. I need to understand how this condition is currently affecting your daily functioning and mood.

speaker: Patient
text: It is very difficult to work at the health food store when I cannot sense the animals, and the burlap I wear helps me cope with the silence. I feel quite isolated living alone since I can no longer share my thoughts with the creatures outside.

speaker: Doctor
text: The burlap clothing and isolation are significant behavioral changes that warrant further exploration. Are you experiencing any hallucinations, such as hearing voices or seeing things that others do not, or do you primarily feel a sense of loss regarding the animal connection?
